[list]
[*] Fixed some achievements not triggering

[/list]

[list]

[/list]

notes.title: Slenderman is BACK! New Slender Reborn game coming this January!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3209910/Slender_Reborn/][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33025535/776cfaf5b2f91a758135e87c76f09da92235c342.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Slenderman is back❗️[/h2]

Rediscover terror in this reimagined classic survival horror. Collect eight pages and evade the relentless Slenderman in a hauntingly realistic world rebuilt with updated graphics, adaptive AI, and immersive sound design. Prepare for unpredictable scares and a chilling atmosphere that redefines fear.

[h3][b]Watch the announcement trailer here:[/b][/h3]
https://youtu.be/v8bnOFQFIMQ

[h3][u][b]Wishlist now[/b][/u] to be the first to know the exact date:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3209910/Slender_Reborn/

[b]He'll haunt👻 you this January - 😱Slender Reborn😱 is coming out on Steam[/b]
